roles.name: Employee
roles.description: Submits expense claims and follows the status of their own. Never sees another employee's claims, the approval queue, or the monthly report.

roles.name: Approver
roles.description: Works the queue of submitted claims, approves or rejects each one, and reads the monthly total of approved claims. Does not file claims in this release. Sees every claim.
